h1: Cup Colour Approval: Pantone, Material & Samples
lead: Use the actual material and a defined viewing condition for colour approval. A colour reference communicates the target, while the agreed sample and acceptance method establish what the project approves.
html:
Give Your Next Sourcing Decision a Clearer Direction

Bring these decisions back to your actual product, drink or brand project. Clear specifications, samples and approval targets help your team work from the same brief.

How should we assess material appearance before choosing a model?

Use the actual material and a defined viewing condition for colour approval. A colour reference communicates the target, while the agreed sample and acceptance method establish what the project approves.

What should the quotation and sample review include?

For cup colour approval: pantone, material & samples, provide the use, model or reference, intended quantity and the information needed to review material appearance, reference lighting and approved sample. Identify essential requirements and undecided items so the quote and sample review address the same brief.

How should a fixed project date be handled?

State the required arrival date and destination at the start. We will assist you with artwork or design, sample approval, production and transit milestones separately. We will help you review the timing impact of any change to an approved specification; service scope and timing need project confirmation.
